notes.schema_note: Sarnia elects two distinct slates of four councillors city-wide, on separate ballot lines: 'Councillor, City' sits on city council only and is keyed 'atlarge'; 'Councillor, City-County' sits on Lambton County council as well and is keyed 'regional councillor', the same key every other upper-tier seat in the study uses. Both are At-large scope - the key is the office's tier, not its geography - so the survey asks them as two questions and the export keeps a Sarnia respondent's county vote in the same columns as a Waterloo or York respondent's.
notes.name_format: Published as 'First Last', unlike most sources; name_raw preserves the published form.
